diagnosis: The root_validator ensures source and destination warehouses are distinct, and the route checks stock availability. However, the route queries Warehouse.id == req.from_warehouse_id without verifying that src_wh.company_id == user.company_id. Any authenticated logistics user can dispatch stock out of a competitor's warehouse.
exploit_request:
POST /logistics/relocate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json
